events.title: Dev Log #4 — Making Chopper
events.summary: After Diana, it's Chopper's turn. Here's the whole middle of the process: one jester, a pair of executioner's shears, and how he ended up looking the way he does. events.title: Dev Log #3 — Making Diana
events.summary: After Mori & Gula, Diana. Here’s how one dark elf with a bow went from two arms to one, and from there to the character she is now.Who she isDiana used to be a marksman people knew by name. Then she lost an arm. When an archer loses an arm, the bow usually gets put down. Diana didn’t put it down. She called a wraith arm into the place where hers had been, took up the bow again, and is now a stronger shot than she ever was.So the heart of this character isn’t what she lost. It’s what came after.

events.title: Dev Log #2 — Making Mori & Gula
events.summary: Last time we promised the shy lich and the hungry staff. Here they are, and here's how they went from a page of horned doodles to the character in the game.Who they areMori is a lich. Not the tower-of-skulls, end-of-the-campaign kind. She's the kind who got the title before she was ready for it. She keeps her eyes hidden behind her bangs, flinches at loud noises, and would honestly prefer that the humans invading the dungeon just went home.Gula is her staff. Gula has opinions.
